sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Hol*? asks where someone or something is. The location phrase normally comes before van in a simple location sentence.

items.english: The book is in the bag.

sections.content: If Hol van a könyv? sounds like something you’d shout while searching for lost car keys, that’s basically the right energy — van here does the same job as English ‘is’ in ‘Where IS my book?!’ Just remember Hungarian keeps van waiting patiently at the end of the sentence instead of rushing it out first.
